concept: A link is a key that travels. One marker world: the budget draft sits inside three rough rings (anyone with the link, people in the company, named people), and the same hand-drawn forward arrow shows how far a link reaches on each setting; the key is drawn early and handed back at the end.
world: One white board world laid out as a grid of boards. Row one is sec1: the hook board (0,0), the presenter spot (2400,0), the rings board (4800,0). Row two is sec2 and sec3: the access board (0,1600), the travel board (2400,1600), the quiz board (4800,1600). Row three is sec4: the checklist board (0,3200), the take-back board (2400,3200), the payoff rings board (4800,3200). A camera pan inside a section reads as the next part of the board; a wipe at each section turn reads as the board wiped clean.

devices.what: the one budget draft page, a rough page with the title Budget draft and three scribbled figure lines; the same page every time (kit part)
one rough hand-drawn key standing for the link: drawn, handed on, later crossed out and returned (kit part)

three concentric rough rings around the budget page: widest anyone with the link, middle people in the company, inner named people with a door and a short name list; one board gains a ring per beat, later the forward stops at an edge or the door (kit part)
the bent marker forward arrow from one holder to the next, the same arrow every time the link travels
a pocket rule written as one line under the board with one accent underline
the wipe join (dir right) at each section turn; camera pans and continue joins inside a section

value_script.why: a clean white board, ink with one accent mark per beat
the key mechanism, how a link travels: rings gain hachure, the board is at its fullest
the close lifts back to a clean board for the checks and the payoff

sections.treatment: Hook drawn on one board (the page, three teammates, a stranger), the presenter names the three choices, then the rings board grows one ring per beat and ends with the first pocket rule.

beats.line: Budget page and three teammate pictograms drawn; a fourth figure in a rough box with a question mark appears reading it.
The forward arrow runs from one teammate to a second figure and on to the stranger, passing the sender by; The link travelled written.
The presenter beside three written words: Who, What they can do, Until when, one per spoken phrase.
The budget page drawn as a door with the rough key beside it; a hand-off arrow passes the key to another holder; A link is a key.
The widest ring drawn around the page, a crowd of pictograms inside, label Anyone with the link.
A middle ring drawn inside it with company pictograms, outsiders left outside; label People in the company.
A small inner ring with three named pictograms and a door that checks a short name list; label Named people.
An arrow from widest to narrowest across the rings; Pick the narrowest that works written under them; a muted note Check your company's rules.

sections.treatment: A fresh board on the budget page itself: view as an eye, edit as a pencil whose change reaches every copy, a copy note that says it depends on the tool, then view first with a small recall sketch of the rings.

beats.line: The budget page with an eye icon; a hand reaches in and the original stays unchanged; View, Read only written.
A pencil marks a figure on the page and the same change appears on three small holder copies; Edit, Changes the original.
The eye again, then a copy arrow from the page to a second sheet; View is not copy-proof, with a muted note depends on the tool.
A tick beside View first, Edit only if they must with a question mark; a small muted sketch of the three rings drawn as a recall.

sections.treatment: The rings redrawn for travel: one forward on the company setting stops at the company edge, on anyone it runs off the board, on named people the door stays shut; the second pocket rule; then the quiz card and its answer.

beats.line: The company ring with three teammates inside; the forward arrow leaves one teammate and reaches a manager figure elsewhere in the ring; Company link, Forwarded once.
The manager opens the page; a second forward arrow stops at the company edge and an outsider is turned back; The link is the permission.
The widest ring drawn and the same forward arrow runs past where the company edge was, off toward the board border; Anyone with the link: no edge.
The forward reaches the inner door; the three name list is checked against the manager and the door stays shut with a cross; Not on the list.
A small note of a listed figure showing the page on; then The link travels. A name does not. written under the board.
Quiz card: three teammates need to read the budget, not change it; three setting and permission options; pause, no answer.
Answer: Named people, view is marked right, the others dim; the company option gets a why not note about the forward.

sections.treatment: A fresh board for the checks before sharing, then the take-back board (key crossed out and returned, a name struck, the shared list reviewed, an expiry date), the payoff redraws the rings calmly, and the presenter closes with three questions and the pocket rule.

beats.line: Four checks written down the board, a hand tick in a rough box beside each as it is spoken.
Beside the list, the budget page with a magnifier and three small tabs: Pages, Comments, Version history.
The key crossed out and an arrow returns it to the sender; a name on the list struck through; Link off or narrower, Remove names.
A rough list of three shared files with one old link ticked off, then a small calendar with Expiry date written.
The rings redrawn calmly: three named teammates in the small ring, the forward arrow stops at the shut door, the key back with the sender; Named people, View only, Switched off after.
The presenter beside three written questions, then the pocket rule Narrowest door. View first. Switch off.
